_note: The learned models that run on the laptop's own GPU, beside the containers (pepin.localization_service, ros/models.sh). Docker on macOS has no GPU, so a network in a container runs on the Docker VM's CPU. 'device' is per model and is a measurement: scratch/models/endpoint_bench.py (2026-09-24) timed each endpoint through the service on both devices.

localization._note: One process, one failure domain: XFeat, LighterGlue and the place model. The depth network is the other process (ros/depth_host.sh, port 8790).

xfeat._note: cpu: through the service (scratch/models/endpoint_bench.py, 2026-09-24, 800x600) XFeat answers in 46 ms median, 54 ms p90 on the CPU against 41-81 ms median and 55-241 ms p90 on MPS, which the depth host's RAFT-Stereo keeps 80 % busy (scratch/models/load_probe.py) and which goes cold within 2 s of idle on this swapping laptop (scratch/models/gpu_idle_probe.py): the CPU is as fast and predictable, and leaves the GPU to RAFT and the place model. cache: the answers kept by the picture's bytes, because RTAB-Map re-extracts the same stored node pictures on every registration (a hit answers in 1-2 ms).

match._note: cpu: LighterGlue matches 2048 keypoints a side in 109-129 ms on the CPU and 518 ms on MPS (scratch/models/endpoint_bench.py, 2026-09-24). min_conf 0.1 is XFeat's own match_lighterglue floor.

place._note: boq_dinov2 on mps: R@1 0.986 evening against the daylight database through the service (scratch/models/place_parity.py), 57 ms on MPS against 167 ms on the CPU (scratch/models/endpoint_bench.py). boq_r50 is the lighter alternative (R@1 0.98, 24 ms, a quarter of the weights, scratch/vpr). A change of model changes every vector's length and meaning: the database's descriptors must be written again (ros/tools/place_backfill.py) before RTAB-Map compares by descriptor.

perception._note: The one camera channel (pepin.perception_service, ros/models.sh job perception, 127.0.0.1:8792): camera_stream POSTs every rectified left eye it publishes (its flag perception_feed, knobs perception_hz / perception_quality), the service keeps ring_s of them and finds faces and people on the newest one at detect_hz; the speaker gaze, person recognition and the see tool read it, and the voice process holds no pixels. The detector's weights and threshold are config/face_sensor.json's models block, the identity net's file config/people.json's face.model: the same networks the snapshot path loads.
perception.note: source: the voice process's start value of the live knob vision.source (service: this service; snapshot: the path before it, ustreamer's /snapshot decoded and searched in the voice process, for a day this service or the camera half is broken; scripts/voice_cascade.py switch --knob vision.source=snapshot). detect_hz: detections a second on the newest frame, newest wins (10: the gaze's track_hz; the ring still takes every frame at the sender's rate). ring_s: seconds of frames kept as they came (20 fps x 77 KB x 10 s = 15 MB). faces: SCRFD's CoreML compute units, ane = CPU and Neural Engine (never the GPU the voice's Qwen3-TTS uses), cpu, coreml (CoreML chooses, the GPU included), mps, none. persons: vision (Apple Vision's human rectangles from the JPEG bytes, Neural Engine) or none. body_head_frac: an upright person's head is this share of their box's height below its top. min_score: faces under it are left out of the records (SCRFD's own threshold is face_sensor.json's det_threshold). identity_device: ArcFace's units for /embed, loaded at the first embedding and let go after identity_unload_after_s idle. look_wait_s: how long a gaze look waits for a record exposed after the head settled (a frame exposed at the settle reaches the service 70-100 ms later and is detected within one detect period). see_wait_s: how long see waits for the first still frame after a head move before it takes the newest one.
